description: EV charging stations near a point. Primary source OpenStreetMap (Overpass): name, operator, network, socket types, capacity, access, hours. For US points when Overpass is unavailable, the US DOE/NREL Alternative Fuel Stations directory is used instead. PlugShare itself has no public API, so its reviews and live status are not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: auto_carsdirect_vehicle when you need CarsDirect used-car listings near a US ZIP code: vehicle; auto_autonation when you need AutoNation cars for sale for a make and optional model. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
